'''Belt Bridge''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that lets 2 transport belts intersect without obstructing each other.|A logistics unit that AIC Factory managers can use to create an organized transport system and avoid the "spaghetti".}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that lets 2 transport belts intersect without obstructing each other.

The Belt Bridge allows a transport belt to go over another without disrupting the flow of items on both belts.

==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Belt Bridging]]
